defects.source: PR #293 CodeRabbit hostile review and hostile re-review P1 recurrence on 2026-08-20
defects.guard_boundary: Markdown-aware artifact parsing and workflow validators plus hostile regression fixtures
defects.guard: security/governance semantics must be derived from rendered Markdown/workflow structure rather than arbitrary text presence; fenced code blocks are masked before heading, metadata, ADR, finding, matrix, PENDING, and verdict parsing, and hostile fixtures prove quoted or fenced templates, incidental tokens, wrong columns, unrelated PR references, unrelated checkout settings, and wording-only assertions cannot satisfy guards

FULL audits require a structured per-ADR accounting entry with an explicit review/applicability disposition for every Accepted ADR; arbitrary ADR mentions do not count; TARGETED re-audits are not forced into repository-wide recertification
review-ready changed audit reports may not contain unresolved PENDING placeholders and mandatory sections must be real level-two headings
reviewed revision is mandatory; mutable PR, Issue, or URL evidence also requires a valid offset-aware evidence cutoff

only explicit prior-review/previous-finding scope triggers re-verification; a current PR reference alone does not; when triggered, the report must identify prior finding references with evidence and decision consequence or explicitly state none exist

Final Verdict must contain one canonical declared verdict line; conditional readiness requires real conditions; blocking verdicts require YES specifically in the labeled Blocks ADR field or the identified Blocks ADR matrix column
